title: A budget-dependent crossover between coverage- and response-based training-set selection for machine-learned interatomic potentials
abstract: arXiv:2609.05877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Selecting compact training sets for machine-learned interatomic potentials requires deciding whether to preserve structural diversity or target configurations on which models disagree. The better choice can depend on how much data is retained, making a comparison at one training-set size insufficient. Here we link selection criteria to prediction accuracy through a budget-resolved comparison of retrained MACE models on GAP-20 Carbon and pooled revised MD17. Structural coverage is compared with a response-guided selector that targets disagreement between a coverage-trained model and a full-data reference. This retrospective response witness tests the value of model disagreement for compressing an already labelled pool. At 5\%, coverage gives smaller absolute deviations from the full-data error than random sampling across four force endpoints in both datasets. translated_title: 机器学习原子间势训练集选择中覆盖度导向与响应导向方法之间随数据预算变化的交叉转变
translated_abstract: 为机器学习原子间势选择紧凑训练集时，需要决定是保留结构的多样性，还是针对模型之间存在分歧的构型。哪种选择更优可能取决于保留多少数据，因此仅在单一训练集规模下进行比较是不充分的。本研究通过对GAP-20 Carbon和合并修订版MD17数据集上重新训练的MACE模型进行按数据预算分辨的比较，将选择标准与预测精度联系起来。研究者将结构覆盖度方法与一种响应导向选择器进行对比，后者针对覆盖度训练模型与全数据参考模型之间的分歧。这种回溯性响应见证方法检验了模型分歧对于压缩已标记数据池的价值。在5%数据保留率下，在两个数据集的四个力端点上，覆盖度方法相比随机采样与全数据误差的绝对偏差更小。见证方法在1%和5%时比覆盖度方法偏差更大，但排序关系……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究揭示了机器学习原子间势训练集选择中，覆盖度导向与响应导向（基于模型分歧）两种策略的优劣会随数据保留预算的变化而发生交叉转变，表明单一训练集规模下的比较不足以确定最优选择策略。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a budget-dependent crossover between coverage-based and response-based training-set selection strategies for machine-learned interatomic potentials, showing that comparisons at a single training-set size are insufficient to determine the optimal selection criterion.
